item.title: Self-checkout and AI are eliminating human contact and job security
item.description: "I think they do need to stop with self-checkout. Sure, people steal, but they steal normally even if they're not using the checkouts. Self-checkouts are taking away from human contact and job security, even though they say it's not. But this is what AI wants, and pretty soon you'll end up having to stand in line each day like a communist country. It is ridiculous. That's my opinion I don't care who likes it or not, thank you." - A Marion County resident shares her opinion. Read more: Self-check

item.title: I think the Somalian frauds in Minnesota are not as bad as farmers who Trump subsidized
item.description: "$12 billion. That is the amount of bailout for farmers who overwhelmingly voted for Trump. Why should my taxes pay to bailout people who are reaping the bitter harvest and consequences of their own actions? Yes, the Somali Minnesota fraud is bad but compared to the farmer bailout, the $20 billion to Argentina bailout, the billion dollar retrofit of a Qatari jet, the billions at risk from Trumps corrupt cryptocurrency- the state fraud pales in comparison to the craven corruption of Trump's admin
